Registers Minos.NET's IDecisionClient in a .NET host, as a default client or as keyed clients, from a client factory, with a pipeline of stages the container builds once. Protocol packages such as Minos.NET.SystemOne build their registrations on it. Native AOT-compatible.

A caching stage for Minos.NET's decision client pipeline: a repeated question set, state, images and model are answered from an in-process IMemoryCache, or from an optional IDistributedCache such as Redis, instead of the provider. Only successes are stored. Native AOT-compatible.

OpenAI's Decisions API, POST /v1/decisions, for Minos.NET's IDecisionClient: GPT-6 Luna with text and image state. The API is in public beta, and this package is built from OpenAI's Decisions guide and not yet tested against the live API. Native AOT-compatible.

Typed, source-generated decision questions for .NET, provider-neutral: the question model, IDecisionClient and its pipeline. Add a protocol package such as Minos.NET.SystemOne to call a provider. Native AOT-compatible and allocation-conscious.

A rate-limiting stage for Minos.NET's decision client pipeline, over System.Threading.RateLimiting: each call takes a permit before it is sent, and a call the limiter rejects returns a RateLimited error without reaching the provider. Native AOT-compatible.

The /v1/systemone protocol for Minos.NET: TypeSafe's Jev API, OpenRouter, vLLM Semantic Router and compatible local servers, with presets, capability checks and DI registration. Native AOT-compatible. Not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe AI, OpenRouter or the vLLM project.
Client for Sendway: send email, SMS and app push, read a message's outcome with a machine-readable failure reason, and verify the signed outcome webhooks (Standard Webhooks).
Domain-focused guard clauses for AppWeaver. Provides static validation methods that throw standard .NET exceptions on precondition failures.
